operating_notes.text: Received notices from BSE and NSE imposing fines of ₹5,42,800 each (inclusive of GST) for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) board composition rules for Q3FY26.
Q4FY26 revenue includes ₹497.03 Cr relating to earlier years recognized pursuant to tariff truing-up and provisional tariff orders.
Installed capacity reached 4,196.5 MW with 1,730 MW added in FY26.
Revenue includes ₹242.59 Cr in arrears from a provisional tariff order for 2024-29.
Etalin HEP (3097 MW) project agreement terminated; ₹738.52 Cr in assets classified as held for sale.
Himachal Pradesh government has indicated intention to take back Luhri, Sunni Dam, and Dhaulasidh projects.
SJVN Thermal Private Limited had paid-up capital of ₹3,131.72 Cr and turnover of ₹520.78 Cr as on 31 March 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,496.47 Cr (+196.7% YoY), net loss ₹117.84 Cr (against a loss of ₹127.72 Cr a year earlier).
SOUMENDRA SOUMEN DAS (DRA DAS) shared the audio recording link for the investor conference call discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 results on May 15, 2026.
SJVN reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,496.47 Cr and a net loss of ₹117.84 Cr, with total installed capacity reaching 4,196.5 MW.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,244.32 Cr (+117.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹657.39 Cr (+113.5% YoY).
SJVN board accorded in-principle approval to merge wholly owned subsidiary SJVN Thermal Private Limited into the parent.

Shareholder approval for final dividend at AGM

watchlist.response: Losses due to lower PLF/CUF during initial ramp-up and fixed costs; expected to turn profitable in FY27 as operations stabilize.

status_history.evidence: Consolidated PAT turned positive at ₹657 Cr in Q2, though SGEL and STPL subsidiaries reported combined net losses of ₹182 Cr.
